text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, so close...!
Just a little bit more."
choice_data_list: I'm sorry I couldn't get it for you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-No way...! Just the thought
alone makes me super happy!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Someone like me doesn't even
really know how to operate a crane, after all."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Just being able to operate it at all is amazing...!
So please, don't let it bother you too much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
